title: Notifications
emptyBody: Notices about your account appear here, a sign-in from a new device for example. They are kept for 90 days.

security.name: Security
security.description: Sign-ins, second factor, password, sessions and recoveries of your account.

administration.name: Administration
administration.description: Notices about the business for managers, expiring credentials for example.

assignment.name: Assignments
assignment.description: What is handed to you, a lead or a job for example.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.intro: Notifications appear in your inbox and, if you want, as a push on your devices – never by e-mail. You alone decide.
preferences.locked: Security notices always arrive immediately, in the inbox and as a push, and cannot be switched off.
preferences.noEventsYet: No notices of this kind yet.
preferences.conflict: The setting was changed elsewhere in the meantime. You now see where it stands.
preferences.failed: The setting could not be saved.

device.title: Push on this device
device.intro: A push shows only the title and leads to the inbox; the content stays in Nexotec. It applies to this device while you are signed in here.
device.enable: Turn on push on this device
device.disable: Turn off push on this device
device.active: Push is on for this device.
device.inactive: Push is off for this device.
device.unavailable: Push is not set up on this installation yet.
device.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
device.denied: The browser blocks notifications from Nexotec. Allow them in the browser settings.
device.failed: Push could not be set up on this device.

newDeviceLogin.title: Sign-in from a new device
newDeviceLogin.body: Your account was signed in from a device it has never been used on before. If this was not you, end that session in My account › Security and change your password.

factorEnrolled.title: Second factor added
factorEnrolled.body: A second factor was added to your account. If this was not you, contact Nexotec support at once.

factorRemoved.title: Second factor removed
factorRemoved.body: A second factor was removed from your account. If this was not you, contact Nexotec support at once.

recoveryCodeUsed.title: Recovery code used
recoveryCodeUsed.body: One of your recovery codes was used to sign in. Left: {{remaining, number}}.

accountLocked.title: Account temporarily locked
accountLocked.body: Your account is temporarily locked after several failed sign-in attempts. If this was not you, reset your password.

passwordChanged.title: Password changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your account was changed. If this was not you, reset it at once and contact Nexotec support.

sessionRevokedByOther.title: Sessions ended by someone else
sessionRevokedByOther.body: One or more sessions of your account were ended by someone else. Sign in again to carry on.

impersonationStarted.title: Nexotec support is working in your account
impersonationStarted.body: A Nexotec support employee is working in your account. You can end the session at any time from the banner.

impersonationEnded.title: Support session ended
impersonationEnded.body: The Nexotec support session in your account has ended.

connectedAccountLinked.title: Connected account linked
connectedAccountLinked.body: An external account was linked to your account. If this was not you, disconnect it in My account › Connected accounts.

connectedAccountRevoked.title: Connected account disconnected
connectedAccountRevoked.body: A connected external account was disconnected. Nexotec no longer acts on your behalf there.

platformRecoveryAction.title: Recovery by Nexotec support
platformRecoveryAction.body: Nexotec support carried out a recovery on your account: {{action}}.
